title: Agent-written experiment code runs only as a frozen, approved protocol and is verified from raw files
user_story: As the owner I want an agent such as Codex to run its own experiment code through the same approval, freezing and independent verification as the built-in protocol, instead of outside governance (live run 2026-10-28; agent/PLAN_6.6.4_L3.md A2).

requirements.description: experiment.propose_protocol snapshots the active code project into a content-addressed store with per-file sha256 and pins the environment (interpreter, version and installed packages, or a Docker image digest). The protocol digest covers code, environment, conditions, seeds and metrics; later project edits never change it.

experiment.run accepts the agent protocol only after researcher approval and an approved mission; it re-checks the frozen code and the environment, then runs every condition x seed once in a fresh process on a fresh copy, within the per-trial and total time budgets, recording raw metrics.json, logs and a paired comparison that needs human review.

experiment.verify re-reads the raw metric files, checks hashes, registration, code and environment, recomputes the aggregation and comparison independently, and records a reproduction only from another separately approved run of the same digest with matching metrics.

nonfunctional: No install, edit, retry or re-plan by the runner
The built-in denoising protocol and its API are unchanged
A 2-condition x 3-seed run completes in a few seconds
inputs: experiment.propose_protocol {topic_id, hypothesis, entrypoint, include, conditions, baseline, seeds, metrics, primary_metric, direction, min_effect, budgets, engine}
outputs: Protocol snapshot {kind, code_digest, code_manifest, environment, trials}
Experiment run with per-trial metrics and comparison
preconditions: An open code project and an existing topic
postconditions: Every agent measurement used as evidence comes from approved, frozen code
acceptance_criteria: OutlinePaperCodePanels.test.tsx shows the frozen files before approval
Existing protocol, governance, mission tool and autonomy suites pass

scenarios.expected: Approved agent code runs 6 trials, finds the method better (+0.10), verifies; a second approved run is recorded as its reproduction
Editing the project after proposing does not change what runs; a new proposal gets a new code digest
A changed frozen file or a changed environment refuses the run before admission
A non-zero exit or a missing registered metric fails the run with retained logs, and verification fails
An edited stored comparison or metric file fails verification
Bad baseline, metric, paths, unpinned Docker or no code project are rejected
No mission or run reference before approval; the reference is single-use
A trial over its 1 s budget is stopped well before it would end
The protocol route accepts agent_code_v1 and still accepts the built-in protocol unchanged

recovery: Fix at agent_protocols; never run unfrozen code, skip approval or relax verification. TASK-AGENT-PROTOCOL-664, max three cycles.
test_environment: Disposable PHDLAB_DATA_DIR and code project (tests/_env.py), real subprocess trials with the test interpreter as the pinned environment; evidence in docs/qa/evidence/agent-protocol-664/.
